articles.author: Reuters Staff
articles.title: Candidate Alpha leads polls in 2026 governor race
articles.description: Alpha maintains a 7-point lead according to the latest polls ahead of the 2026 governor election.
articles.content: Candidate Alpha leads polls in the 2026 governor race with a significant margin over opponents, according to a new survey released Monday.

articles.author: AP Staff
articles.title: 2026 governor race update: Alpha ahead in polls
articles.description: New polling data shows Alpha continuing to lead in the 2026 governor race with a 6-point margin.
articles.content: Polling data released Tuesday confirms Alpha maintains a lead in the governor race, putting pressure on rivals.
